item.title: Reminder: US markets are closed today
item.description: That will make for a quieter start to the new week, not least with Chinese markets also out today. As a reminder, it will be a one week break for China in conjunction with the Lunar New Year holidays. So, that will sap out a chunk of liquidity in Asia trading at least for the week ahead.Anyway, the US holiday today gives markets some added time to digest the key happenings from last week. US data took center stage with the non-farm payrolls and inflation numbers being released on the same week.
